name: io.github.getanyapi-com/anyapi
description: Hundreds of scraping & data APIs through one key. USD pay-per-request, normalized schemas, failover.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AnyAPI API key as a Bearer token (format: Bearer aa_live_...). Mint one at https://getanyapi.com/dashboard/keys. Discovery works without a key; running an API requires one.
